About me

Hi, my name is Felix and I'm a project manager, front-end web developer and digital strategist based in the most beautiful city in the world, Munich, Germany.
I started my career as an Event Manager, handling projects for the automotive and pharmaceutical industry.

I have gained experience in event and tradeshows for automotive, pharma and various other branches. I have worked with clients like BMW, BMS, Gilead and many more.
I have a strong background in project management and digital strategy, which allows me to understand the needs of my clients and deliver results that exceed their expectations.

I've decided to make a change and broaden my portfolio. That's why you see this website.
I'm combining project management with technical and web development skills to meet today's employer needs.
